span_hash_convention: sha256 over the exact lines a..b (1-based, inclusive) joined with "\n" plus one trailing "\n"; for LF files this is byte-identical to `git show <rev>:<path> | sed -n "a,bp" | sha256sum`. File hashes are sha256 of `git show <rev>:<path>`.

critic_span_check.convention_equivalence: Each span hash equals `git show ecfa11276:<path> | sed -n "a,bp" | sha256sum` (checked for these three spans); the file has no CR bytes and ends with a newline.

critic_comparison.compared_by: session 5f, after the command center's adjudication of #796 (item task-native-agent-stack-5f-20261006T165010Z, P2)

verdict_rule: COUNTS: a completed read of real market data (bars, quotes, trades, snapshots, auctions, screeners, corporate actions or news served by a market-data API; OPRA; FINRA short volume), or a real paper or broker session that consumed it, whose data dates fall inside the window and which no known_reads item covers. Window membership is judged by the dates of the data read, not the run date. OUT: synthetic or fixture-only, not run, data dated outside the window, no market data (filings, documents, account state), covered by a known_reads item, a local re-read inside a bound item's scope, or a wrapper of another record.
access_kind_rule: data_read: the record shows only data, counts or coverage. result_inspected: the record shows per-case results (fills, realized P&L, flags, ranks). outcome_selected: names were chosen by a realized outcome (a gain or move threshold, a ranking by realized return, a known mover). Where one scope mixes kinds and the record cannot split it, the stronger kind is proposed and flagged.
scope_kind_note: universe_date_range and event follow D4.1's spellings. security_date is proposed for single-security scopes; no D4.1 fixture defines that token (PREREGISTRATION.md:44: "one security on one date").
ticker_policy: No tickers appear in this file; sets are described by class with the source line that lists them.

known_reads_check.note: D4.1 pins only the 2021Q1 ETF control; the 2022 identity sample has no fixture (D6-O-K11). D6-G02 is a separate 2021Q1 read of LEAN-bundled bars that includes stocks.

item_order: COUNTS first, then OUT; ids sorted within each verdict
double_count_check: No COUNTS item re-binds a scope a known_reads item already pins. D6-C05/C06/C07, C09 and C10 bind only the parts outside their known read's D4.1 range or universe, and each names that known read. OUT items D6-O-K01..K15 map every other record of the five known reads.
